moworks.notes: px @320x200. Track 4 px from x 40 to 280; 4 nodes (r 5) at 60 / 127 / 193 / 260 under reward cards 44 x 40 (r 7); nodes 1-2 done (accent + check). Progress fills node 2 → 3 in 0.4-1.2 s inOut. At 1.2 s card 3 bumps 14 % (300 ms half-sine), its accent fill and light gem cross-fade in, an outline grows +10 px over 500 ms outCubic, fading; node 3 turns accent. Card 4 stays dim with a lock and 'NEXT'. Label fades in 1.35-1.6 s; reset 2.45-2.72 s. Params: tiers: số mốc (4) · from / to: bậc (7 → 8) · fill: thời gian chạy (0.8 s) · reachAt: lúc tới (1.2 s).
